acceptanceCriteria: Alias limit raised to 128 bytes, and the refusal names the limit.
plan accepts witnessed rows as explicit rerun entries, does not require non-core rows, and excludes BLOCKED/DEFECT unless listed.
An optional PARTIAL (or per-step progress) state exists and never counts as witnessed.
Witness events accept optional bounded provenance fields testCommit, environmentTree and evidenceRef plus the test title; show reports them per witness.
A 110-row ledger with 78-character ids seeds; a plan listing witnessed regression rows and omitting non-core rows passes.
body: From GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#1071 (2026-10-17). Migrating a real per-ticket obligation ledger hits: (1) alias cap 64 bytes (TOL-V0-034..036) refuses 60 of 4,562 ids, e.g. a 78-char id MALFORMED without the limit in the message; (2) plan refuses ALREADY_CLOSED for intentionally listed witnessed regression rows and UNASSIGNED for optional non-core rows; (3) BLOCKED and DEFECT rows count as open for planning; (4) no PARTIAL state for rows with some steps witnessed; (5) a witness lacks test-repository commit, environment tree, evidence ref and test title. Related: V1-1199 (aliases in plan documents), #1070.
title: ticket obligations migration blockers: alias length, plan rerun/non-core/BLOCKED semantics, PARTIAL state, witness provenance (issue #1071)
